tasks.title: Research Grok Bot public architecture
tasks.detail: Maintain source-linked facts, inference, VYREN design, and unknowns. Subham's xAI design article pass now maps bot roster, presence, computer preview/takeover, inline artifacts, role memory, and routines to VYREN.

tasks.title: Map the agent runtime loop
tasks.detail: Document planning, context, tool routing, observation, verification, recovery, memory, and handoff contracts.

tasks.title: Install global engineering skills
tasks.detail: Install and verify agent-skills, Ponytail, and gstack at pinned revisions.

tasks.title: Launch live progress board
tasks.detail: Serve a local Kanban board backed by this task file, with live updates and activity history.

tasks.title: Build searchable code knowledge index
tasks.detail: Index source files, symbols, and import relationships incrementally for bounded search.

tasks.title: Define VYREN first vertical slice
tasks.detail: Reviewed first-slice contract: authenticated brand ownership is a prerequisite; bounded MongoDB task aggregate carries atomic state, evidence, attempts, and progress. No backend code yet.

tasks.title: Establish bot owner/brand scope and evidence truth
tasks.detail: Gate 1 prerequisite: authenticate bot ownership and brand scope; enforce target scope at tool execution and distinguish synthetic from observed evidence.

tasks.title: Build Instagram image-post workflow after bot foundation
tasks.detail: Later gate: after one durable bot, multi-bot collaboration, computer/workspace, and bounded shared memory, build the cited Instagram image draft and per-post review flow.

tasks.title: Test new and existing brand journeys
tasks.detail: Verify new and existing brand onboarding, account scope, evidence quality, taste feedback, and the human publication boundary.

tasks.title: Align VYREN around social-media operations
tasks.detail: Record Subham's narrower thesis, owned learning loop, platform adapter and policy gate, build sequence, frontend gap review, and open product decisions.

tasks.title: Set initial customer, platforms, and publication authority
tasks.detail: Confirmed: solo founder/creator first, Instagram and X first, per-post approval, Higgsfield candidate for images and reels. First end-to-end format and taste metrics remain separate decisions.

tasks.title: Validate platform execution routes
tasks.detail: Instagram professional-account publishing path and per-post API flow mapped from Meta's official collection; VYREN app/account eligibility unverified. X action matrix still to research.

tasks.title: Define persistent bots, model routing, and action boundary
tasks.detail: Map documented Grok Bot primitives to VYREN: persistent role bots, shared brand workspace, direct/group messaging, and per-bot screens; distinguish VYREN-only model routing and action service.

tasks.title: Validate Higgsfield media gateway
tasks.detail: Official image route and async lifecycle documented. Existing provider returns synthetic success without calling Higgsfield. Account access, exact schema, cost, and live receipt remain unverified.

tasks.title: Define quality and taste metrics for Instagram image post
tasks.detail: First Instagram image post rubric defined: reviewer decision and edits, brand voice, source accuracy, image relevance, accessibility, then sourced outcome metrics after publication.

tasks.title: Design the owned taste-learning loop
tasks.detail: Specify versioned brand taste, reviewer feedback, outcome signals, offline evaluation, rollback, and later bounded reinforcement learning.

tasks.title: Replace simulated Higgsfield success with real media jobs
tasks.detail: Later media gate, after the one-bot foundation: credentials are not configured; current provider returns synthetic success. Label sandbox outcomes, then implement authenticated jobs and scoped receipts.

tasks.title: Map xAI Grok Bot design article to VYREN
tasks.detail: Read Subham's linked primary article and add its missing UX principles: bot-first roster, presence, progressive computer visibility, inline artifacts, role-scoped context, and routines.

tasks.title: Design and prove one persistent bot
tasks.detail: Current first agenda: one durable bot identity, role/configuration, scoped memory, restart-safe task runtime, versioned skills, typed tools, capability checks, and truthful results. Design contract recorded; implementation and tests pending.

tasks.title: Expand to multiple persistent bots and handoffs
tasks.detail: After Gate 1, add direct/group collaboration with role-scoped memory, one task owner, and no implicit authority transfer.

tasks.title: Add virtual computer and per-bot sessions
tasks.detail: After multi-bot core, design tenant-isolated computer, separate bot screens/sessions, bounded shared workspace, credential custody, preview, takeover, and recovery.

tasks.title: Govern bounded shared brand memory
tasks.detail: Define promotion from bot observations, brand/project memory scope, contradiction handling, source precedence, and retrieval tests before shared-context execution.

tasks.title: Review VYREN customer pain and differentiation
tasks.detail: CEO strategy review: pain is plausible, category is crowded, product-specific willingness to pay unproven. Proposed chief-of-staff wedge and validation experiment; scope changes remain pending Subham's decision.

tasks.title: Audit authenticated owner and brand path
tasks.detail: Auth and brand path audited; owner-derived scope implemented in the first bot route. Focused anonymous/cross-owner tests pass; required Phase 30 baseline is 81/81.

tasks.title: Create and retrieve one durable bot
tasks.detail: Owner-scoped create/get passed focused tests and live MongoDB verification. Bot identity persisted across a new Python process and MongoDB restart; other-owner reads returned 404. Phase 30 suite: 81/81.

tasks.title: Show durable bot in studio
tasks.detail: Team workbench shows the signed-in founder's persisted Content Producer and local draft. Browser creation, audit, and full-reload retrieval passed on 23 October. Future team features remain clearly labeled as planned.

tasks.title: Persist scoped bot memory
tasks.detail: Approved role memory with source, expiry, contradiction exclusion and owner/brand/bot scope passed focused tests and live MongoDB process-restart verification. Cross-owner reads returned 404.

tasks.title: Persist bot task and recover session
tasks.detail: Owner-scoped task and local preview survive process restart. An expired WORKING lease becomes BLOCKED, then an explicit retry uses a fresh session and completes the same task without duplicate work. Focused and live MongoDB recovery checks pass. Model-backed execution remains a later slice of OS-030.

tasks.title: Enforce versioned skills and tool capabilities
tasks.detail: One versioned read-only memory skill/capability checks exact scope and binding, persists allow/deny/failure audit, and labels owner-provided content as unverified external evidence. Live audit survived a MongoDB restart; negative tests pass.

tasks.title: Produce one reviewable social draft
tasks.detail: Signed-in Team UI produced and reloaded one local deterministic caption concept with source, route, uncertainty, audit, and unapproved state. Model-backed execution and its blocked/source-failure paths remain open.

tasks.title: Verify and review one-bot foundation
tasks.detail: Checkpoint: 12 focused tests, Phase 30 suite 81/81, prior Next.js production build, MongoDB restart/recovery, audit, cross-owner checks, and signed-in founder-to-local-draft browser reload pass. Model-backed execution and final review remain open. Repository-wide lint has existing findings.

tasks.title: Validate founder pain with real workflows
tasks.detail: Acceptance: interview script uses recent actual work, disconfirming evidence logged, four-week pilot bars preregistered. Verify: review script/evidence ledger with Subham. Parallel to Gate 1; external outreach requires authorization.

tasks.title: Triage existing team stream authorization
tasks.detail: Static audit found /api/team/stream/{session_id} has no auth or owner check while replaying messages. Reproduce safely, then fix at the route boundary before reusing team rooms. Also review provisioning's forced email_verified flag. Separate from Gate 1 bot path.

tasks.title: Triage frontend lint backlog
tasks.detail: The patched scoped brace-expansion override restores ESLint execution. Whole-repository lint reveals 95 source errors and 298 warnings; triage and fix in reviewable batches without disabling rules. Gate 1 Team files have zero errors and one existing unused-state warning.

tasks.title: Redesign Team as a one-bot colleague workbench
tasks.detail: Subham chose a fresh visual direction centered on one trusted Content Producer. The fixture roster and simulated attention/progress UI were removed; the new page has identity, brief-to-draft work, sourced memory, audit and truthful capability limits. Team sign-in no longer shows the global fake-work carousel. Anonymous browser visual check, type check, targeted lint and production build pass. Signed-in and mobile visual checks remain.

tasks.title: Make Team and quick menu reachable across the dashboard
tasks.detail: Home dock now links directly to Team. The existing draggable radial menu appears on dashboard pages while Studio and Settings keep their own action handlers; Team is available as a menu shortcut. Anonymous browser checks on Home and Team passed.

tasks.title: Fix account dropdown placement in dashboard header
tasks.detail: The account menu had sidebar positioning and opened above the top header outside the viewport. It now opens below the trigger, right-aligned and viewport-bounded. Credits, Profile, and Help now resolve to working destinations; Credits selects the Usage & Compute tab. Browser checks passed on Home, Team, and Settings; scoped type and lint checks pass.

tasks.title: Stabilize Studio header and Home prompt composer
tasks.detail: Aligned the fixed Studio header with the workspace top offset and made the signed-in account control readable. Isolated radial-menu CSS from Studio's broad composer stylesheet, removed the Home prompt's rotating typewriter state and an unmount state update. Browser checks cover Studio, Home refresh, Studio-to-Home navigation, typed prompt rendering, and quick-menu settings. Type and scoped lint checks pass. Isolated production build could not finish because fonts.googleapis.com was unreachable; normal build also collided with the running dev server's .next output.

tasks.title: Define campaign-workspace capability boundaries
tasks.detail: Subham approved the capability boundaries and dependency order. The map separates scope, approval, bot instances, conversations, runtime, manager, memory, computer sessions, and UI. Module specification work has begun; no multi-bot implementation has started.

tasks.title: Specify campaign ownership and isolation
tasks.detail: Subham approved the campaign-scope specification. It defines the owner/tenant/brand chain, scoped campaign API, migration quarantine for ownerless records, cross-campaign tests, and compatibility questions. Implementation planning is separate and under review.

tasks.title: Plan campaign-scope implementation
tasks.detail: Subham approved the separate campaign-scope plan. It preserves the unfinished Gate 1 plan and orders ownerless-access hardening, scoped identity, assets and background work, archive/versioning, migration, and campaign switching. Implementation cards are prepared; no campaign-scope code has changed.

tasks.title: Restore focused campaign tests and capture denial cases
tasks.detail: Acceptance: a repeatable local Python command runs focused tests; new tests reproduce ownerless, foreign-owner, broken-chain and nonexistent campaign behavior without changing production data. Verify: focused test command produces an interpretable red baseline; record environment fix. Depends on approved plan. Likely files: test_campaign_scope.py and test setup only.

tasks.title: Fail closed on legacy campaign access
tasks.detail: Acceptance: one resolver denies missing/foreign ownership on every existing campaign read, write and SSE entry point with indistinguishable 404; same-owner behavior remains. Verify: focused route tests and required Phase 30 suite 81/81. Depends on OS-042. Likely files: campaigns.py, campaign_store.py, test_campaign_scope.py.

tasks.title: Checkpoint legacy campaign authorization
tasks.detail: Acceptance: ownerless, foreign and missing campaign IDs have the same denial on all mounted legacy routes including SSE; no production fixture is assumed owned. Verify: targeted route inventory and focused tests plus Phase 30 81/81; save evidence. Depends on OS-043. Likely files: tests and docs/agent-os evidence record.

tasks.title: Persist immutable campaign owner and brand scope
tasks.detail: Scoped model, owner/brand resolver, indexes, scoped update predicate and broken-chain denial are implemented; 18 focused and 81 Phase 30 tests pass. Fresh-process MongoDB persistence check remains because local port 27017 is not running. Acceptance still requires restart proof. Depends on OS-044.

tasks.title: Create and list scoped campaigns safely
tasks.detail: Brand-scoped create, owner/brand-filtered list, 201 response, stable retry key, payload conflict, and unique owner/key index are implemented. 18 focused tests, Phase 30 81/81, and frontend production build pass. Cursor pagination, actual concurrent Mongo retry, and restart proof remain. Depends on OS-045.

tasks.title: Inventory legacy campaign ownership without writing
tasks.detail: Acceptance: dry-run report separates fully scoped, owner-known/brand-unknown and ownerless records; repeat run is stable and does not expose private contents or alter assets. Verify: fixture migration tests and before/after counts. Depends on OS-045. Likely files: backend inventory script, campaign_store.py, migration tests, docs evidence.

tasks.title: Version campaign changes and make archive reversible
tasks.detail: Acceptance: stale rename/archive updates return 409; archived campaigns stay readable but reject new work; hard delete cannot bypass scoped rules. Verify: focused state tests and Phase 30 81/81. Depends on OS-045 and OS-046. Likely files: campaign.py, campaign_store.py, campaigns.py, test_campaign_scope.py.

tasks.title: Checkpoint durable campaign API
tasks.detail: Acceptance: two owned campaigns survive process restart, foreign/brandless records are excluded, retry creates one campaign, and archive/version rules hold. Verify: focused suite, Phase 30 81/81, API response compatibility review. Depends on OS-046, OS-047 and OS-048. Likely files: tests and docs evidence.

tasks.title: Protect local campaign image delivery
tasks.detail: Acceptance: local campaign images require resolved owner/brand/campaign scope; direct static-path or traversal access is denied; owner image retrieval still works. Verify: HTTP tests for owner, anonymous and foreign requests; Phase 30 81/81. Depends on OS-045 and OS-049. Likely files: main.py, asset_store.py, campaigns.py, asset-access tests.

tasks.title: Verify Supabase campaign asset privacy
tasks.detail: Acceptance: inspect current Storage bucket policy and official docs; campaign material URLs no longer assume public access; owner-only retrieval works and foreign access fails. Verify: storage integration/contract test and frontend build if client changes. Depends on OS-050. Likely files: asset_store.py, campaigns.ts, storage tests, docs evidence. No live bucket change without reviewed policy.

tasks.title: Carry campaign scope through workers and streams
tasks.detail: Acceptance: upload, analysis, generation, credit spend, callbacks and SSE re-check exact campaign scope; foreign or archived campaigns cannot start new work or receive another campaign's events. Verify: focused async/SSE tests and Phase 30 81/81. Depends on OS-049, OS-050 and OS-051. Likely files: campaigns.py, campaign_store.py, async boundary tests.

tasks.title: Show real scoped campaign switching
tasks.detail: Acceptance: signed-in founder creates and switches two real campaigns and reloads each state; archived/unmigrated states are truthful and example metrics are not shown as live. Verify: type check, production build, signed-in browser run. Depends on OS-046, OS-048 and OS-052. Likely files: campaigns.ts, campaigns/page.tsx, actual Studio selector component, browser evidence.

tasks.title: Migrate only owner-confirmed legacy campaigns
tasks.detail: Acceptance: only reviewed owner-to-brand mappings are applied idempotently; IDs, creative state and assets survive; ownerless records remain quarantined. Verify: dry-run diff, repeat-run tests and owner access check. Depends on OS-047 and OS-052 plus separate review of the real mappings before any live write. Likely files: migration script, campaign_store.py, migration tests, docs evidence.

tasks.title: Verify campaign isolation end to end
tasks.detail: Acceptance: cross-owner/brand/campaign API and asset denials, restart persistence, migration replay and archive rules all pass; two-campaign signed-in browser proof and diff review recorded. Verify: focused tests, Phase 30 81/81, frontend type/build, browser evidence. Depends on OS-053 and OS-054; no later bot module starts before this gate.
